answer: Each identity books one haven night and files a nebula occultation timing through an onyx filter. The haven auditor recomputes it from the ephemeris and filed photometry, burning the bond beyond tolerance. First night 44 credits; the k-th pays 44+6(k-1), so the 1000th pays 6038 and 1000 fakes cost 3,041,000 plus 70,000 locked in 70-credit bonds, as window nights are rivalrous and queue-priced. A copied-timing ring fails: one night sold to many keys shows identical dip times, while each real night has a unique atmospheric signature. An honest agent pays 44 once and reclaims its bond.
